reviewMethod: All 12 selected stored body images across five current-corpus papers were independently checked against the fresh read-only GitHub evidence artifact. The review verified exact task/page/article/source DOI binding, original Figure/Scheme identity and independent caption, captureVersion/job identity, fixed media generation 1790082000000, content-addressed R2 key, actual bytes/full SHA256, content-hash prefix, byte length/type/dimensions, duplicate source/hash ownership, current deployed same-ID state and separation from official TOC. Seven SVG files were parsed and rendered and checked for active or external content; five PNG files were decoded and dimension-checked. Every image was visually reviewed against its owning caption and paper theme for body-image role, unrelated/recommendation contamination, duplicate risk and legibility. Capture success/partial/controller/transport history was treated only as provenance evidence, not semantic approval. No publisher request, R2/D1 write, direct import/repair, literature/card/title/scope mutation, userscript change or media-generation change was performed.
quality: All 12 selected files matched their complete SHA256, byte lengths, dimensions, content-hash prefixes and strict content-addressed R2 identity. No selected full hash or source URL had cross-DOI ownership in the frozen evidence inventory. All five papers retain independent official TOCs; none of the selected images is an official-TOC substitute. The JACS body Figure 1 remains body-only; its previously published Figures 3 and 4 are separate approved records and remain untouched. Article-level capture is partial for 10.1021/acs.joc.6c01939 (2/5), 10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03443 (1/4), and 10.1021/jacs.6c13635 (3/4). The latest article-level report for 10.1021/acs.joc.6c01846 is 0/0, but the three selected current-generation stage records have exact DOI-bound Silverchair sources, verified bytes and internally consistent server evidence markers; this per-image approval does not imply article completeness. 10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03851 is complete 5/5. Missing figures are not inferred approved, and transport/HTTP/controller checkpoints are not assigned to VPN, R2, quota or publisher causes.
